title: Best Robotic Arm (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Picks were based on mentions in PCMag (source 0) and CNET (source 1) for the Saros Z70, and product listings in Dobot’s catalog (source 2) and a research paper (source 4).
assumptions: No price info was used except the $2,599 listed by CNET; other products had no price data.

verdict.line: Buy it if you want a robot vacuum that can also pick up small items. It offers strong vacuuming, mopping, excellent mapping and threshold crossing, plus the unique OmniGrip arm. The catch is the arm still struggles with object handling and software bugs.
